source: 【麦门雅思】2026年9-12月口语Part1新题（只录题目，不含示例回答）

questions.text: Would you like to use a computer or tablet?
questions.text_zh: 你喜欢使用电脑还是平板吗？

questions.text: In what conditions would you use a computer or tablet?
questions.text_zh: 在什么情况下你会使用电脑或平板？

questions.text: When was the first time you used a computer or tablet?
questions.text_zh: 你第一次使用电脑或平板是什么时候？

questions.text: What would your life be like without computers or tablets?
questions.text_zh: 如果没有电脑或平板，你的生活会是什么样的？

questions.text: In what conditions would it be difficult for you to use a computer or tablet?
questions.text_zh: 在什么情况下，你会觉得使用电脑或平板很困难？

questions.text: What will you do if you find something lost by others?
questions.text_zh: 如果你捡到别人丢失的东西，你会怎么做？

questions.text: Do you report to the police when finding something lost by others? Why?
questions.text_zh: 如果捡到别人丢失的东西，你会向警察报告吗？为什么？

questions.text: Have you ever lost things?
questions.text_zh: 你有没有丢过东西？

questions.text: Will you post on social media if you lose your item?
questions.text_zh: 如果你丢了东西，你会在社交媒体上发布消息吗？

questions.text: Have you ever lost your keys?
questions.text_zh: 你有没有丢过钥匙？

questions.text: Do you collect things?
questions.text_zh: 你会收藏东西吗？

questions.text: Are there any things you have kept from your childhood?
questions.text_zh: 有没有什么东西是你从童年一直保留到现在的？

questions.text: Would you keep old things for a long time? Why?
questions.text_zh: 你会把旧东西保存很长时间吗？为什么？

questions.text: Where do you usually keep things you need?
questions.text_zh: 你通常把需要的东西放在哪里？

questions.text: What do people usually buy on the street market?
questions.text_zh: 人们通常会在街市上买什么？

questions.text: Do you prefer to go shopping in the shopping mall or on the street market?
questions.text_zh: 你更喜欢去购物中心购物，还是去街市购物？

questions.text: When was the last time you went to a street market?
questions.text_zh: 你上一次去街市是什么时候？

questions.text: Are there many street markets in China?
questions.text_zh: 中国有很多街市吗？

questions.text: Have you made any crafts with paper?
questions.text_zh: 你有没有用纸做过手工？

questions.text: Do you still write physical letters?
questions.text_zh: 你现在还会写实体信件吗？

questions.text: Do people still keep handwritten letters today?
questions.text_zh: 现在人们还会保存手写信件吗？

questions.text: Do you carry paper and pens with you when you go out?
questions.text_zh: 你出门的时候会随身带纸和笔吗？

questions.text: What did you like to do with paper as a child?
questions.text_zh: 你小时候喜欢用纸做什么？

questions.text: How often do you eat fruit and vegetables?
questions.text_zh: 你多久吃一次水果和蔬菜？

questions.text: Where do you usually buy fruit and vegetables?
questions.text_zh: 你通常在哪里购买水果和蔬菜？

questions.text: What kind of fruits and vegetables do you dislike?
questions.text_zh: 你不喜欢什么种类的水果和蔬菜？

questions.text: Were there any kind of fruits and vegetables you disliked as a child?
questions.text_zh: 你小时候有没有不喜欢的水果或蔬菜？

questions.text: How did you learn to be polite as a child?
questions.text_zh: 你小时候是如何学会礼貌待人的？

questions.text: Do you think being polite is very important?
questions.text_zh: 你认为礼貌待人很重要吗？

questions.text: On what occasions should we be polite?
questions.text_zh: 什么样的场合我们应该礼貌？

questions.text: What did you do to show your politeness as a child?
questions.text_zh: 你是小孩的时候，会怎么样展示你的礼貌？

questions.text: Is waste sorting common in your country?
questions.text_zh: 中国垃圾分类普遍吗？

questions.text: Did you recycle when you were a kid?
questions.text_zh: 你小时候会回收垃圾吗？

questions.text: What do you do when you see rubbish on the street?
questions.text_zh: 当你看到街上的垃圾时，你会怎么做？

questions.text: How do you recycle things like paper and plastic?
questions.text_zh: 你是如何回收纸张和塑料之类的东西的？

questions.text: Do you often feel tired?
questions.text_zh: 你经常感到疲惫吗？

questions.text: When would you feel tired?
questions.text_zh: 你什么时候会感到疲惫？

questions.text: What do you do when you feel tired?
questions.text_zh: 当你感到疲惫时，你会做什么？

questions.text: When you feel tired, do you still go out with your friends?
questions.text_zh: 觉得累的时候，你也会仍然出去跟朋友玩吗？

questions.text: Do you prefer to sit by the window when traveling?
questions.text_zh: 旅行的时候，你更喜欢坐在靠窗的位置吗？

questions.text: Did you have a long journey with your family as a child?
questions.text_zh: 你小时候有没有和家人进行过长途旅行？

questions.text: Do you like buying shoes? How often?
questions.text_zh: 你喜欢买鞋吗？多久买一次？

questions.text: Have you ever bought shoes online?
questions.text_zh: 你有没有在网上买过鞋？

questions.text: How much money do you usually spend on shoes?
questions.text_zh: 你通常在鞋子上花多少钱？

questions.text: Which do you prefer, fashionable shoes or comfortable shoes?
questions.text_zh: 你更喜欢时尚的鞋子还是舒适的鞋子？

questions.text: Do you often see advertisements when you are on your phone or computer?
questions.text_zh: 你经常在手机或电脑上看到广告吗？

questions.text: Is there an advertisement that made an impression on you when you were a child?
questions.text_zh: 你小时候有没有哪个广告给你留下了深刻印象？

questions.text: Do you see a lot of advertising on trains or other transport?
questions.text_zh: 你在火车或其他交通工具上会看到很多广告吗？

questions.text: Do you like advertisements?
questions.text_zh: 你喜欢广告吗？

questions.text: What kind of advertising do you like?
questions.text_zh: 你喜欢什么类型的广告？

questions.text: Do you remember your first day at secondary school?
questions.text_zh: 你还记得你上中学的第一天吗？

questions.text: Were there any subjects that you found difficult at secondary school?
questions.text_zh: 你在中学时有没有觉得哪些科目很难？

questions.text: What was your favourite subject at secondary school?
questions.text_zh: 你在中学时最喜欢的科目是什么？

questions.text: Is there anything you miss about your secondary school?
questions.text_zh: 你有没有什么怀念中学生活的地方？

questions.text: Is it easy for you to remember people's names?
questions.text_zh: 你觉得记住别人的名字简单吗？

questions.text: How do you remember people's names?
questions.text_zh: 你是怎么记住别人的名字的？

questions.text: How do you feel when people can't remember your name?
questions.text_zh: 如果被人记不得你的名字你有什么感觉？

questions.text: Do you often forget people's names?
questions.text_zh: 你会经常忘记别人的名字吗？

questions.text: Do you often feel bored?
questions.text_zh: 你经常感到无聊吗？

questions.text: When would you feel bored?
questions.text_zh: 你什么时候会感到无聊？

questions.text: What do you do when you feel bored?
questions.text_zh: 当你感到无聊的时候，你会做什么？

questions.text: Do you think childhood is boring or adulthood is boring?
questions.text_zh: 你觉得童年生活无聊，还是成年生活无聊？

questions.text: Is there a difference between where you meet friends now and where you used to meet them in the past?
questions.text_zh: 你现在和朋友见面的地方，和过去和朋友见面的地方有什么不同吗？

questions.text: Why are some places suitable for meeting while others are not?
questions.text_zh: 为什么有些地方适合见面，而有些地方不适合？

questions.text: Do you prefer to spend time with one friend or with a group of friends?
questions.text_zh: 你更喜欢和一个朋友待在一起，还是和一群朋友待在一起？

questions.text: Would you invite friends to your home?
questions.text_zh: 你会邀请朋友来你家吗？

questions.text: How important are friends to you?
questions.text_zh: 朋友对你来说有多重要？

questions.text: Do you often go out with your friends?
questions.text_zh: 你经常和朋友出去吗？

questions.text: Where do you often meet each other?
questions.text_zh: 你们经常在哪里见面？

questions.text: What do you usually do with your friends?
questions.text_zh: 你通常和朋友一起做什么？

questions.text: Do you have a friend you have known for a long time?
questions.text_zh: 你有没有一个认识很久的朋友？
